scope: Official NYC-wide supplemental public datasets; source-specific coverage and dates apply.
data_use: Public agency data. Source metadata and attribution retained; no assertion of a broader license where unspecified. No accounts or secrets used. Raw files are never automatically force-loaded in the browser.

datasets.title: Hurricane Evacuation Zones
caveats: Emergency evacuation planning zones; not flood probabilities or FEMA insurance zones.
No zone or absence from this layer is not a no-flood-risk finding.
datasets.join_strategy: Point-in-polygon for zone context only; confirm current evacuation instructions separately.

browser_derivatives.method: EPSG:4326; 6 decimal coordinates; topology-preserving simplification 10m

datasets.title: Parks Properties
caveats: Each record is a Parks acquisition/property, not necessarily an independent public park or entrance.
Includes partially managed property; accessible recreation and canopy are not inferred.
Retired records are retained with the native flag.
datasets.join_strategy: Distance to geometry can describe proximity; do not equate a polygon boundary with an accessible entrance.

browser_derivatives.method: EPSG:4326; 6 decimal coordinates; topology-preserving simplification 5m

datasets.title: MTA Subway Stations
caveats: Station centroids, not entrance locations or walking times.
Multiple stations may share one complex. ADA status and service can change.
datasets.join_strategy: Nearest station centroid (approximate distance); retain station versus complex identifiers.

browser_derivatives.method: Source coordinates; native fields plus id,label,source

datasets.title: FDNY Firehouse Listing
datasets.publisher: Fire Department of New York City (FDNY)
caveats: Firehouse locations only; proximity does not determine emergency response time, staffing or capacity.
datasets.join_strategy: Nearest facility location or exact BBL/BIN where recorded.

browser_derivatives.method: Source coordinates; native fields plus id,label,source

datasets.title: Health Facility General Information
datasets.publisher: New York State Department of Health
caveats: Actual source data contain 17 facility types, beyond the stale hospitals/extension-only catalog description. Retain and filter the native description.
Coordinates are geocoded mailing addresses; emergency departments, available beds and travel times are not inferred.
datasets.join_strategy: Nearest location filtered by facility type; do not treat clinics as full emergency hospitals.

browser_derivatives.method: Source coordinates; native fields plus id,label,source
Filter native description exactly Hospital or Off-Campus Emergency Department; no availability/ED capability inference

datasets.title: Community Districts
caveats: Planning community districts are statistical/context areas, not parcel-specific measurements.
datasets.join_strategy: Point-in-polygon to boro_cd; annual air data use matching CD identifiers.

browser_derivatives.method: EPSG:4326; 6 decimal coordinates; topology-preserving simplification 10m

datasets.title: Air Quality and Health Impacts
datasets.publisher: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)
caveats: Neighborhood surveillance/model summaries, not on-site monitors or real-time/indoor air.
Annual, summer and winter means coexist; do not combine time/measure types.
PM2.5 and NO2 use different units. Preserve measure_info and geography type.
datasets.join_strategy: Match geo_type_name and geo_join_id; CD joins community districts, never use an ID without its geography type.

browser_derivatives.method: EPSG:4326; 6 decimal coordinates; topology-preserving simplification 10m

datasets.title: NYC Building Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2023 to Present (Data for Calendar Year 2022-Present)
caveats: Latest native report_year observed at retrieval is 2024; year_ending confirms calendar year 2024.
Owner-submitted benchmarking covers reporting properties, not all NYC buildings.
A Portfolio Manager property may include multiple BBLs/BINs; do not allocate aggregate energy/GHG to one building or double-count linked lots.
Missing or nonnumeric values remain null with raw source values; reported data quality alerts retained.
Do not infer spare electric capacity, utility reliability, or compliance from consumption.
datasets.join_strategy: Exact BBL/BIN arrays to a reporting property; retain portfolio identity, year and many-to-many relationship.

coverage.identifier_validation: Syntax only: borough 1–5, BBL ten digits with nonzero block/lot; BIN seven digits. Existence in an authoritative tax-lot/building registry is not asserted; raw source strings retained.

browser_derivatives.method: BBL-prefix shards; full records preserve shared portfolios

datasets.title: NYC Urban Tree Canopy Assessment Metrics 2010
caveats: Historical 2010 canopy assessment metrics; not current shade, parcel temperature or future growth.
datasets.join_strategy: Use the documented spatial aggregation; do not interpolate a neighborhood percentage to a parcel.

browser_derivatives.method: EPSG:4326; 6 decimal coordinates; topology-preserving simplification 10m

datasets.title: NYC Stormwater Flood Maps
caveats: Modeled potential flooding under specified rainfall intensity and sea level conditions; not observations or unconditional probabilities.
Keep the 1.77, 2.13 and 3.66 inches/hour scenarios and current/2050/2080 sea levels distinct.
No modeled coverage is not a safe-site determination; retain source depth/category definitions before scoring.
datasets.join_strategy: Full-resolution scenario geometry for spatial context; overview geometries are display-only.
